New tutorial: deploy Google’s Gemma 3 on your own dedicated GPU server.

Using vLLM + Docker on Ubuntu, you get a private OpenAI-compatible endpoint that handles text and images. The guide covers:

picking a model size for your GPU
NVIDIA driver and Container Toolkit setup
securing your Hugging Face token
running it under systemd
multi-GPU scaling and troubleshooting

Read more: https://www.fitservers.com/tutorials/howto/deploy-gemma-3-gpu-server/
